sentences.en: I'd like to have a look at your stamp collection.
sentences.zh: 我想看看你的邮票收藏。

sentences.en: The audience showed their impatience with a stamping of feet.
sentences.zh: 观众用跺脚的方式表达了他们的不耐烦。

sentences.en: He has many foreign stamps, not to mention Japanese ones.
sentences.zh: 他有很多外国邮票，更不用说日本的了。

senses.zh: 铭记；标出；盖章于…；贴邮票于…；用脚踩踏 -
